results.title: Who is the greatest Indian classical vocalist?
results.snippet: Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi (/ˌbiːmsɛn ˈdʒoʊʃɪ/; BHEEM-SAYN joe-SHEE; 4 February 1922 – 24 January 2011), also known by the honorific prefix Pandit, was one of the greatest Indian vocalists in the Hindustani classical tradition from the Indian subcontinent.

results.title: Who is the Indian classical singer Pandit?
results.snippet: Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty (born 25 December 1952) is an Indian classical vocalist, composer, lyricist and an exponent of the Patiala-Kasur gharana.
